title: DhwaniTTS v1.6 Ultimate Update
short_msg: 4 Engine Modes, Crystal-Clear Hindi Pronunciation, and Persistent Notification Inbox!
full_msg:
Welcome to the ultimate DhwaniTTS release by ITFB! This update includes:-
1. Four Pro Engine Modes: Dhwani Natural, Sonic, Crisp, and Turbo.
2. Zero-Stutter C++ Anti-Babble & Smart Pronunciation Lexicon for clear Button/App names.
3. Monster Voice Bug completely fixed with intelligent sample-rate resampling.
4. Permanent Notifications & Updates Inbox where all announcements stay saved until deleted.
5. Back Button fix and TalkBack cursor stability.

Tap below to download and install the latest APK directly!
